hooks.text: 世界分为千人共享大地图与独立地牢，地牢每层重排遭遇、危险和战利品
hooks.excerpt: Soulbound splits its world in two: a shared overworld full of quests and adventure, and brutal instanced dungeons that never play the same way twice. Every floor reshuffles encounters, hazards, and loot and every room unlocks new relics that warp your abilities in ways you didn't plan for.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 十余种能力沿分支遗物形成100余种组合，可把火球变连锁闪电或让战锤范围伤害吸血
hooks.excerpt: 100+ Ability and Relic Combos To Build Out Enter the dungeon and pick from 10+ abilities that create unique class builds with branching relic paths. Stack a chain-lightning relic on your mage's Pyrosphere and watch mobs evaporate. Layer life-steal onto a berserker's hammer and turn your AoE into a heal for your party. Every relic run offers new synergies you've never tried, and the best builds are the ones nobody planned.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 种田、烹饪、采集与采矿都会反哺地牢，提供体力、装备材料和职业武器工作站
hooks.excerpt: Every life skill feeds back into your progression with cooking restoring stamina, gathering unlocking crafting materials for gear and buffs and mining unlocking crafting stations to build the weapons that defines your class.
